title: Fiber-Resolved Microstructure Quantification from Multi-Shell Diffusion MRI using Detection Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2609.39184v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fiber orientation and compartmental microstructure are central to the characterization of white matter tissue in diffusion MRI, yet existing methods either resolve fiber orientations without quantifying microstructure, or quantify microstructure while assuming a fixed number of compartments and a single fiber direction. Nonparametric approaches that recover both require tensor-valued diffusion encoding and computationally expensive Monte-Carlo inversion of an ill-posed inverse Laplace transform. We propose to reframe this problem as an object detection-like task, adopting the Detection Transformer (DETR) architecture to jointly predict mean diffusivity (MD), fractional anisotropy (FA), main fiber direction, and signal fraction for a variable number of compartments per voxel from standard multi-shell diffusion MRI with linear encoding. translated_abstract: 纤维取向和区室化微结构是扩散MRI中白质组织表征的核心，然而现有方法要么在不定量微结构的情况下解析纤维取向，要么在假设固定数量区室和单一纤维方向的前提下定量微结构。能够同时恢复两者的非参数方法需要张量值扩散编码，以及计算代价高昂的病态逆拉普拉斯变换的蒙特卡洛反演。我们提出将这一问题重新构建为类似目标检测的任务，采用检测Transformer（DETR）架构，从具有线性编码的标准多壳层扩散MRI中，联合预测每个体素中可变数量区室的平均扩散率（MD）、各向异性分数（FA）、主纤维方向和信号分数。训练过程中使用匈牙利匹配来解决区室之间的排列不变性问题。我们引入了m……
tldr: 本文将扩散MRI微结构定量问题重构为目标检测类任务，首次采用DETR架构从标准线性编码的多壳层数据中联合预测每个体素可变数量区室的MD、FA、主纤维方向和信号分数，无需张量值扩散编码或代价高昂的逆拉普拉斯变换蒙特卡洛反演。
en_tdlr: This paper reframes fiber-resolved microstructure quantification from multi-shell diffusion MRI as an object detection-like task, employing a DETR architecture to jointly predict MD, FA, main fiber direction, and signal fraction for a variable number of compartments per voxel, eliminating the need for tensor-valued diffusion encoding or computationally expensive Monte-Carlo inversion of the inverse Laplace transform.
